energy.gov — Kansas State University Technical Design Report for the 2021 U.S. Department of Energy Collegiate Wind Competition — 2021 — https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2021-11/ksu-designreport-2021.pdf
(opened by the member, not cited)
Aero-Rotor Lead said about it: Department of Energy Collegiate Wind Competition (E2) which states the final turbine was a 3-bladed, fixed-pitch, direct-drive assembly with passive centrifugal Revolutions Per Minute (RPM) control, and I adopt that layout for the tri-star rotor (C1) plus rigid hub (C3).
Aero-Rotor Lead said about it: The same TSR 6 gives rotor speed (E14) 1.43e+03 RPM at 5 m/s and (E13) 3.15e+03 RPM at 11 m/s for direct-drive matching (C4), while wind dynamic load scale (E15) 37.3 N at 22 m/s is about 3.80 kg weight, easily carried to the post but requiring stall limiting; I read (E3) shows soft stall in 4 to 9 deg angle range and (E2) shows unloaded overspeed near 4300 RPM, so I add soft-stall sections (C7) to cap thrust and speed.
